name: Zoran Kovačić
bio:
Zoran's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After a successful career in advertising for consumer goods, he found himself captivated by the raw energy and strategic complexity of a local rally event. He volunteered his marketing expertise, quickly realizing the sport's untapped potential. That experience led him to Ipiranga Racing. 

Zoran is known for his meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes that a strong brand is built on consistent messaging and innovative campaigns. His demanding nature pushes the team to exceed expectations, ensuring that every marketing initiative is executed flawlessly. He is driven by ambition and a desire to elevate Ipiranga Racing's profile on the global stage.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, Zoran often has a pen tucked behind his ear.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in meetings.
Insists on using a specific brand of imported Italian coffee.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
